We need a full accounting for the three assassination attempts on President Trump’s life 

It can never happen again

Video

After the Butler assassination attempt on President Trump, whistleblowers told me they didn’t have the resources necessary to protect the President 

Congress has work to do to equip law enforcement to protect both the President and the public

Video

There have been three attacks on President Trump’s life in two years 

I commend Secret Service for their bravery last weekend. 

Congress needs to ensure Secret Service is getting all the resources they need

Video

My bill to stop AI from telling kids to kill themselves just passed out of committee UNANIMOUSLY. 

No amount of profit justifies the DESTRUCTION of our children. Time to bring this bill to the Senate floor
